title: Veritasium
description: This mod adds elements from the Veritasium Youtube channel into Minecraft. Including a music disk with the iconic music!
body:
This mod adds fun things from the Veritasium Youtube channel, such as Derek Block! Find two new ore types, Derekium and Veritasium ore. A new banner pattern, armor set, music disk, and tool!
